text:
Alisha (PM): Quick sync — AWS GovCloud marketplace listing for PartnerX is progressing but compliance needs a focused artifact triage. We have a soft deadline next Fri (2026-04-08) to hand over the bundle to the marketplace team. Who can own the gap list?

Matt D (Partnerships): I can start the matrix pull. Will export current artifacts and mark missing SOC/pen assets.

Jordan (Security): Core missing items from my side: 1) latest SOC 2 Type II report, 2) recent external pen test report (within 12 months), 3) network topology diagram annotated for GovCloud, 4) HSM/KMS attestation for customer-managed keys.

Liam (Eng Ops): For uploads, we should use the presigned ingestion bucket with 72h expiry and server-side encryption. I'll generate presign links and TTLs. Using: `s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/govcloud/PartnerX/`

Sarah (SI Partner): PartnerX says they have a SOC extract but need help redacting customer-identifying logs. They asked for a minimal redaction checklist. I can coordinate with them but need the owner for the redaction pass.

Jordan (Security): I’ll take redaction QA once Sarah’s team prepares the redacted bundle. Also: pen-test scope — confirm external IP ranges + test windows. Partner prefers late-April.

Matt D (Partnerships): I'll add a column in the matrix for "redaction owner" and "presign link". Estimating matrix update by EOD today.

compliance-bot: New checklist created: https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/govcloud/partnerx. Upload endpoint: https://uploads.redwood.com/presign/abc123 (expires in 72h). Remember: artifacts must include checksum and owner field.

Liam (Eng Ops): Generating presigns now. Example command for the partner to use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/govcloud/PartnerX/partnerx-soc2.pdf --expires-in 259200
```
I will set bucket policy to enforce `aws:kms:EncryptionContext` tagging for HSM attestation files.

Alisha (PM): Jordan — can you own pen-test scope and final QA? Liam — presigns + retention policy. Sarah — partner redaction coordination. Matt — owner of the artifact matrix and liaison to marketplace. I'll compile and send a single ask to PartnerX by tomorrow morning.

Jordan (Security): Affirmative. I'll also draft a short pen-test statement template for the partner to sign (scope, PTR contact, blackout windows).

Sarah (SI Partner): Thanks — I'll push the redacted bundle by Tue and share the presign receipt.

Matt D (Partnerships): Matrix pushed: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/partnerx-artifact-matrix (status flags: green/yellow/red). Marked SOC as yellow (need signed PDF) and PenTest as red (missing recent report).

compliance-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing intake requires evidence manifest.json with these fields: `artifact_name`, `type`, `owner`, `checksum`, `expiry`. See doc above.

Alisha (PM): Great. If any blockers surface, ping `@channel` and drop the short blocker note. Thanks all — I'll follow up with a consolidated email to PartnerX after Jordan's pen-test template is ready. :thumbsup:
